limitations.note: The rewrite corrected the light sequence but asserted red during reset and removed the original three-clock startup delay before red first lights and the counter reloads.
The replacement removed the four public state parameters, so existing instantiations that override those parameters would no longer elaborate even though the ports were preserved.
The test expected immediate red on reset and a countdown from 9 on the first released edge, so it validated the rewrite's startup timing instead of detecting the regression.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The first simulation command was rejected because of its cleanup trap, so the agent had to resubmit the test before it could run.
